title: Malicious code in vreqtx-b5w3n-testmetest (npm)
description: The npm package 'vreqtx-b5w3n-testmetest' version 1.0.1 contains malicious code that loads a platform-specific native addon which reads an encrypted or packed executable payload disguised as a cache file. This payload is written to a hidden temporary location and executed as a detached process on both Linux and Windows systems. The malware includes extensive anti-analysis and sandbox evasion techniques targeting CI environments, container detection, ptrace debugging, and Windows debugging tools. The package metadata is minimal and appears to be a staging artifact, indicating a deliberate attempt to disguise the malicious activity.
